249: Yuki Nagato is a quiet high school freshman that is the only member of the SOS Brigade that was not "voluntarily arrested," or coerced into joining, by Haruhi Suzumiya. She lives alone in the same apartment complex as Ryouko Asakura.
251: Haruhi Suzumiya is the founding member of the SOS Brigade with the purpose of finding aliens, time travelers and espers. She is incredibly eccentric and usually anti-social, with no interest in "ordinary" humans.
252: Kyon is a first-year high school student enrolled in North High, and his real name is unknown; instead being referred to by everyone by the nickname "Kyon". This nickname was created for him by his aunt and then spread by his little sister.
253: Mikuru Asahina, a shy and timid girl with a childish naïveté, is the only character other than Kyon to be brought into the SOS Brigade against her will. Considered one of the most beautiful girls in high school, Mikuru is as kind, caring and thoughtful as she is beautiful.
254: Itsuki is the last member to have joined the SOS Brigade, having been recruited by Haruhi Suzumiya as a "mysterious transfer student". Itsuki is constantly smiling and always speaks in a formal and polite manner.
255: At first, Ryouko appears to be a compassionate and hard-working high school girl. One of Kyon's friends, Taniguchi, places her in the top three first-year girls in the school with a grade of AA+: indicative of her pleasant personality, beauty, and athleticism.
256: Tsuruya is the hyperactive friend of Mikuru, notable for her loud voice, ankle-length hair, and prominent tooth. She possesses a cheerful and friendly disposition.
257: Taniguchi is a loud high school student enrolled at North High who is good friends with both Kunikida and Kyon. Taniguchi is comically lascivious; giving a "score" of attractiveness to each first-year girl based upon his tastes and preferences.
258: Kunikida is a quiet high school student enrolled at North High who is good friends with both Taniguchi and Kyon. Kunikida is much quieter than Taniguchi with the latter doing most of the talking when the two are hanging out.
882: Arawaka is a butler in The Melancholy of Haruhi Suzumiya. Not much is known about him, but it is revealed that he is a member of the Agency and one of Koizumi's contacts. He is usually seen with Mori, another Agency member who takes on the appearance of a maid.
883: A member of the Agency. Her normal appearance is that of a maid.
884: Tamaru Keiichi's younger brother who also stayed at the mansion.
885: The owner/master of the house on the island from episode 9.
912: Not much is revealed about Kyon's fifth-grade sister; not even her real name is given. Other characters simply refer to the eleven-year-old as Kyon's (Younger) Sister or Little Sis.
3621: The teacher of Haruhi and Kyon's classroom.
3622: The umpire for the baseball game that the SOS Brigade participated in.
9143: A soft-spoken, well-groomed second-year student with long, light green hair, Emiri first appears in "Mysterique Sign" seeking counsel from the SOS Brigade claiming she is the girlfriend of the Computer Research Society president,
12335: He is the President of the Computer Research Society Club, which shares a room adjacent to the SOS Brigade. The President is never given a name other than "Computer Society President" or variations upon that term.
12660: Shamisen is a stray cat selected by Haruhi to play the role of Yuki's familiar for their film "The Adventures of Mikuru Asahina", Shamisen is unusual in the sense that he is a male calico cat.
27353: Bass Player for the Band Enoz featured in episode 12 of the Melancholy of Haruhi Suzumiya
44635: Mizuki Okajima (岡島瑞樹) is a character in the Haruhi Suzumiya Anime. She is the drummer of the Rock band, ENOZ.
